stories.author: @Watchlistdarling
stories.text:
Shabbat Shalom Rabbi. As a non Jew (looking into conversion) Hasidic - Orthodox is my favorite stream of Judasim by far.. 

For a guy like me. It SAVED me. The more I learn, the more I consume. I understood the Value of Torah and the Talmud, Zohar, etc, from the moment I first discovered your Instagram reels Rabbi. They simply changed my life and from thereon, after my lifespan so far and on a spiritual journey as well. This is where I find my soul fitting in place. Even if I am not accepted into Ultra Orthodox Judasim, or maybe I may not make the cut. I will work my hardest because all that I am taught does not feel like a chore and it makes SENSE. Out of ANY religion I have studied, Judasim unfortunately has been my last "mainstream" religion to look into. But the GLORY of Israel, the Jews then and now is undeniable! 

Glory to Hashem.

My country is B L I N D Rabbi! 

Once this new job and its first check settles, I will begin to donate

stories.author: @isaacabramovich3168
stories.text:
Kvod Ha Rav,
I just viewed with disgust, the debate you and your young protégé were having with these whatever you want to label them. They had NO RESPECT for you or the young guy with you by by practically throwing non-kosher food at you. The other thing was all the cursing you had to endure alongside side all the very RUDE, RUDE behavior. 

That whole display of arrogant, nasty behavior was way below you. I was truly bothered by how you debased yourself by allowing them to even be in your presence and polluting your air.  
The goes for your partners, of course.  At least, in your debate with the Christian professor, he was respectful of you and the debate was interesting to watch. 

Please Rav, I became Observant because of you and so I really think that so-called debate was horrible.  
Be well.
